selection: NWB unit 201, peak electrode selected by the largest negative trough of its recorded waveform_mean across the AP channels in its units/electrodes region, matched to the AP store by channel_name. The stored sorter extremum_channel_index is retained separately, not assumed to be a physical AP channel index. The 200-ms excerpt starts 10 ms before the first post-60-s window containing six assigned spikes within 180 ms. The violating example uses NWB unit 60's first post-60-s pair between 0.5 and 1.5 ms on its own mean-waveform peak electrode. This cluster passes SNR, presence-ratio and amplitude-cutoff gates but fails ISI QC. All native raw-excerpt samples are retained; only the recorded ADC-to-uV gain and offset are applied to raw voltage. No filtering, interpolation, smoothing, clipping or spike-time detection is performed on those raw excerpts. The separate 500-ms SNR excerpt starts at the same sample and replays the analyzer's saved phase shift, high-pass filter, channel slices and median reference using SpikeInterface 0.103.0. It is not the original random sample used to estimate saved noise: that computation used 20 random 500-ms chunks with seed=None; their exact original positions were not saved.
